title: Coach
statementMd:
A programming coach has $*n*$ students to teach. We know that $*n*$ is divisible by $3$. Let's assume that all students are numbered from $1$ to $*n*$, inclusive.

Before the university programming championship the coach wants to split all students into groups of three. For some pairs of students we know that they want to be on the same team. Besides, if the $*i*$-th student wants to be on the same team with the $*j*$-th one, then the $*j*$-th student wants to be on the same team with the $*i*$-th one. The coach wants the teams to show good results, so he wants the following condition to hold: if the $*i*$-th student wants to be on the same team with the $*j*$-th, then the $*i*$-th and the $*j*$-th students must be on the same team. Also, it is obvious that each student must be on exactly one team.

Help the coach and divide the teams the way he wants.

## Input

The first line of the input contains integers $*n*$ and $*m*$ $(3 ≤ *n* ≤ 48$, ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/babb38e387fa78be46ba7de9507b97ce0c3a0986.png). Then follow $*m*$ lines, each contains a pair of integers $*a*_{*i*}, *b*_{*i*}$ $(1 ≤ *a*_{*i*} < *b*_{*i*} ≤ *n*)$ — the pair $*a*_{*i*}, *b*_{*i*}$ means that students with numbers $*a*_{*i*}$ and $*b*_{*i*}$ want to be on the same team.

It is guaranteed that $*n*$ is divisible by $3$. It is guaranteed that each pair $*a*_{*i*}, *b*_{*i*}$ occurs in the input at most once.

## Output

If the required division into teams doesn't exist, print number `-1`. Otherwise, print ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/3fd2941ef9a7bdc91b7d0b8372f289e78e262c96.png) lines. In each line print three integers $*x*_{*i*}$, $*y*_{*i*}$, $*z*_{*i*}$ ($1 ≤ *x*_{*i*}, *y*_{*i*}, *z*_{*i*} ≤ *n*$) — the $*i*$-th team.

If there are multiple answers, you are allowed to print any of them.
statementZhMd:
一位程序设计教练要指导 $*n*$ 名学生。已知 $*n*$ 能被 $3$ 整除。假设所有学生的编号从 $1$ 到 $*n*$（包括 $1$ 和 $*n*$）。

在大学程序设计锦标赛之前，教练想把所有学生分成若干个三人小组。对于某些学生对，我们知道他们希望在同一支队伍中。此外，如果第 $*i*$ 名学生希望与第 $*j*$ 名学生在同一支队伍中，那么第 $*j*$ 名学生也希望与第 $*i*$ 名学生在同一支队伍中。为了让队伍取得好成绩，教练希望满足以下条件：如果第 $*i*$ 名学生希望与第 $*j*$ 名学生在同一支队伍中，那么第 $*i*$ 名和第 $*j*$ 名学生必须在同一支队伍中。同时，显然每名学生必须且只能属于一个队伍。

请帮助教练按照他的要求分配队伍。

## 输入格式

输入的第一行包含整数 $*n*$ 和 $*m*$ $(3 ≤ *n* ≤ 48$, ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/babb38e387fa78be46ba7de9507b97ce0c3a0986.png)。接下来 $*m*$ 行，每行包含一对整数 $*a*_{*i*}, *b*_{*i*}$ $(1 ≤ *a*_{*i*} < *b*_{*i*} ≤ *n*)$——编号为 $*a*_{*i*}$ 和 $*b*_{*i*}$ 的学生希望在同一支队伍中。

保证 $*n*$ 能被 $3$ 整除。保证每一对 $*a*_{*i*}, *b*_{*i*}$ 在输入中最多出现一次。

## 输出格式

如果不存在满足要求的分组方式，输出数字 `-1`。否则，输出 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/3fd2941ef9a7bdc91b7d0b8372f289e78e262c96.png) 行。每行输出三个整数 $*x*_{*i}$、$*y*_{*i}$、$*z*_{*i}$ ($1 ≤ *x*_{*i}$, *y*_{*i}$, *z*_{*i}$ ≤ *n*$)，表示第 $*i*$ 个队伍。

如果有多种答案，可以输出任意一种。
